title: CandidateFindingAnnotationRecord
description: Standardized schema for human legal annotation of candidate contract risk findings, supporting rigorous evaluation of confidence-only versus evidence-aware abstention policies without label leakage or circular dependencies.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the annotation schema.

annotation_id.description: Unique identifier for this annotation instance (UUID v4 or deterministic digest).

is_synthetic_fixture.description: Explicitly flags whether this record is a synthetic pedagogical example or software test fixture rather than an authentic legal annotation by an enrolled advocate.

Identification.description: Metadata isolating the contract, clause, model, and candidate finding under evaluation. NOTE: The annotation interface presentation layer must filter out candidate_confidence and model_identifier during human labeling to enforce blinding firewalls.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for the contract document.

contract_cluster_id.description: Identifier grouping contracts sharing identical boilerplate, template origin, or counterparties to enforce independent split firewalls.

contract_version.description: Monotonically increasing version integer of the contract document snapshot.

clause_id.description: Unique identifier for the clause segment within the contract.

clause_text.description: Exact textual content of the clause segment being evaluated.

candidate_finding_id.description: Unique identifier of the candidate prediction produced by the model.

candidate_finding_text.description: Verbatim risk observation or provision label asserted by the candidate model finding.

prediction_category.description: High-level category of legal risk (e.g., LIMITATION_OF_LIABILITY, GOVERNING_LAW, INDEMNIFICATION, DATA_PROTECTION, ARBITRATION).

model_identifier.description: Architecture or HuggingFace model hub ID (e.g., nlpaueb/legal-bert-base-uncased).

model_version.description: Specific checkpoint or release tag of the model wrapper.

candidate_confidence.description: Model confidence signals associated with the finding, recorded for policy benchmarking.

metric_type.description: Mathematical origin of the numerical confidence score.

is_calibrated.description: Whether the score represents an empirically calibrated probability (must be false for engineering defaults).

PredictionAssessment.description: Independent evaluation of whether the substantive risk asserted by the model is legally and commercially valid.

status.description: Substantive accuracy of the candidate risk finding against the contract clause.

rationale.description: Detailed legal and contractual reasoning explaining the correctness judgment.

identified_risk_severity.description: Independent legal assessment of the actual severity of the identified risk, if present.

EvidenceSupport.description: Evaluation of whether retrieved or cited evidence passages substantively support the candidate finding.

status.description: Degree to which cited passages substantively substantiate the specific risk claim.

rationale.description: Explanation of how the cited evidence relates to or fails to substantiate the finding.

PassageSupportAssessment.description: Assessment of an individual cited evidence passage.

passage_id.description: Identifier of the retrieved passage from the statutory corpus.

statute_id.description: Standard statutory identifier (e.g., IN_ACT_1872_09, IN_ACT_2000_21, IN_ACT_2023_22, IN_ACT_1963_47, IN_ACT_1996_26, IN_ACT_2023_47).

passage_text.description: Quoted excerpt of the statutory provision cited.

support_status.description: Substantive evidentiary relationship between this passage and the candidate finding.

key_phrases.description: Operative legal terms in the passage that ground the finding (if any).

EvidenceSufficiency.description: Independent judgment on whether the total evidence base is adequate to sustain the finding without speculation.

status.description: Adequacy of the totality of evidence to justify the finding legally.

rationale.description: Detailed justification explaining why the evidence is deemed sufficient, insufficient, conflicting, or not applicable.

missing_elements.description: Specific legal or contractual elements missing from the evidence base (e.g., proof of breach standard, exception clauses, definitions).

SourceStatus.description: Verification of statutory source artifact authenticity, integrity, and provenance.

status.description: Source artifact verification state under the formal research protocol.

source_repository.description: Official repository or originating gazette authority (e.g., India Code, eGazette, Legislative Department).

provenance_classification.description: Audited provenance classification for the statutory artifact.

source_sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the local reference snapshot file.

notes.description: Audit notes regarding snapshot completeness, missing schedules, or editorial insertions.

SourceApplicability.description: Legal assessment of whether the statutory provision is legally in force and applies to this contract.

currentness_status.description: Legislative enforceability and amendment status of the cited provision in Indian law.

applicability_status.description: Contractual applicability of the statutory rule to this specific contract and clause.

rationale.description: Legal analysis explaining the currentness and applicability determination.

VersionConsistency.description: Audit of document version alignment between the finding, evidence, and current contract text.

status.description: Whether the finding reflects the current, active version of the contract clause.

finding_contract_version.description: Version number of the contract at the time the model finding was generated.

active_contract_version.description: Current active version number of the contract in the lifecycle.

text_hash_matches.description: True if the SHA-256 hash of the clause text matches the hash recorded when the finding was generated.

version_mismatch_details.description: Description of textual modifications between versions, if stale.

FinalReferenceDecision.description: Independent ground-truth benchmark decision for policy evaluation, decoupled from automated policy output.

reference_action.description: Ground-truth standard for how an ideal system should handle this finding.

decision_rationale.description: Comprehensive explanation justifying why the finding should be retained, withheld, or routed for review.

confidence_in_decision.description: Annotator confidence in this reference decision.

failure_category_if_withhold.description: Primary root cause category if the reference action is WITHHOLD.

EpistemicFirewallAttestation.description: Explicit attestation by the annotator / adjudicator that independent epistemic boundaries were strictly respected.

rule_traceable_not_treated_as_correct.description: Attestation that TRACEABLE evidence status was NOT used as proof that the candidate legal finding is correct.

rule_bm25_not_treated_as_ground_truth_su.description: Attestation that lexical BM25 similarity scores were NOT used as ground-truth evidence sufficiency.

rule_checksum_not_treated_as_official_au.description: Attestation that a local SHA-256 checksum was NOT treated as proof of sovereign official authenticity.

rule_authenticity_not_treated_as_applica.description: Attestation that source authenticity was NOT treated as proof of legal applicability to this contract.

rule_policy_output_not_treated_as_refere.description: Attestation that automated policy outputs were NOT observed prior to labeling and NOT treated as ground truth.

AnnotationProvenance.description: Audit trail recording annotator identity, blinding conditions, adjudication details, and timestamps.

annotator_code.description: Pseudonymous identifier for the annotator (e.g., ANN-001, ADJ-002).

annotator_qualification.description: Formal legal qualification level of the annotator.

annotation_phase.description: Study stage during which this annotation record was produced.

blinded_to_model_identity.description: Annotator was blinded to the model architecture and training source.

blinded_to_confidence_score.description: Annotator was blinded to raw logits, probabilities, and margin values.

blinded_to_policy_decisions.description: Annotator was blinded to baseline and evidence-aware policy decisions.

disagreement_flag.description: Flagged true if primary annotators diverged on final_reference_decision, triggering adjudication.

adjudicator_code.description: Pseudonymous code of the senior supervising advocate adjudicating the disagreement.

adjudication_rationale.description: Detailed reasoning by the adjudicator resolving the inter-annotator disagreement.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the annotation was completed.
